message.content:
Based on the screenshot of the "Create a new repository" page for **tokcalc**, here is a detailed inventory of every UI element requiring copy, including its current state and what text it should contain:

1.  **Page Title (Header):** Currently displays **"General"**. This is the main heading for this section of the form.
2.  **Label: Owner:** Currently displays **"Owner *"**. Identifies the repository owner field. The asterisk denotes it is required.
3.  **Dropdown: Owner Selection:** Currently populated with **"stevecrates489-commits"**. This is an interactive dropdown to select the user or organization that will own the repo.
4.  **Label: Repository Name:** Currently displays **"Repository name *"**. Identifies the name input field. The asterisk denotes it is required.
5.  **Input Field: Repository Name:** Currently contains the text **"tokcalc"**. This is where the user types the URL-friendly name of the project.
6.  **Validation Message (Success):** Currently displays **"✓ tokcalc is available."** in green. This is dynamic feedback confirming the name isn't taken.
7.  **Helper Text / Callout:** Currently displays **"Great repository names are short and memorable. How about miniature-tribble?"**. This provides naming suggestions, including a clickable link (**"miniature-tribble"**) to auto-fill the field.
8.  **Label: Description:** Currently displays **"Description"**. Labels the optional summary field.
9.  **Input Field: Description:** Currently **Empty**. A large text box intended for a brief summary of the project.
10. **Character Counter:** Currently displays **"0 / 350 characters"**. Dynamic text showing the current length relative to the limit.
11. **Section Header:** Currently displays **"Configuration"**. The heading for the second step/section of the form.
12. **Label: Visibility:** Currently displays **"Choose visibility *"**. Labels the privacy setting dropdown.
13. **Helper Text (Visibility):** Currently displays **"Choose who can see and commit to this repository"**. Explains the purpose of the visibility setting.
14. **Dropdown: Visibility Selection:** Currently set to **"Public"**. Allows toggling between Public and Private.
15. **Label: README:** Currently displays **"Add README"**. Labels the option to initialize the repo with a readme file.
16. **Helper Text (README):** Currently displays **"READMEs can be used as longer descriptions. About READMEs"**. Includes a link to documentation.
17. **Toggle Switch (README):** Currently set to **"Off"**. A binary switch to enable/disable the file creation.
18. **Label: .gitignore:** Currently displays **"Add .gitignore"**. Labels the option to include a gitignore template.
19. **Helper Text (.gitignore):** Currently displays **".gitignore tells git which files not to track. About ignoring files"**. Includes a link to documentation.
20. **Dropdown: .gitignore Template:** Currently displays **"No .gitignore"**. Allows selecting a template (e.g., Python, Node).
21. **Label: License:** Currently displays **"Add license"**. Labels the option to add an open source license.
22. **Helper Text (License):** Currently displays **"Licenses explain how others can use your code. About licenses"**. Includes a link to documentation.
23. **Dropdown: License Selection:** Currently displays **"No license"**. Allows selecting a specific license type (e.g., MIT, Apache 2.0).
24. **Primary Action Button:** Currently displays **"Create repository"**. The final submission button to generate the repo.
